Stephen Curry is primarily known as a three-point shooter and guard who excels at perimeter scoring, but he is also a skilled ball-handler and finisher around the rim. A reverse layup is a common basketball move used to avoid shot blockers by laying the ball in on the opposite side of the rim. While Curry is not famous for reverse layups specifically, he is capable of finishing creatively near the basket, so this action is plausible for him in a game situation.
